scope: Portable source-publication checks; not a recognition benchmark

coverage: Partial assignment against exhaustive small-matrix oracle
Finite deterministic support statistics and unchanged inputs/model state
Synthetic cohort freshness and split separation
Float32/float64 interpolation roundoff, rejection of invalid input, and unchanged RNG/input

example_smoke_check.inputs: Deterministic synthetic RGB fixture and its horizontal flip; no dataset photographs
example_smoke_check.purpose: Checks that scratch initialization, checkpoint writing and the portable example execute; not accuracy evidence
example_smoke_check.release_tested: 0.8.0; valid-input numerical compatibility separately confirmed for 0.8.1

experimental_accuracy: Not asserted; original fresh run stopped on a numerical boundary check, and the complete corrected rerun is in progress.
